build_GRUTransformerModel: build a GRUTransformerModel by calling build_encoder with args, source dictionary, and embed tokens
build_GRUTransformerEncoder: build a GRUTransformerEncoder with args, dictionary, and embed tokens to create a bidirectional GRU contextualized encoder
review_GRUTransformerEncoder_forward_emb: review the GRUTransformerEncoder forward_embedding method that contextualizes token embeddings through a bidirectional GRU layer
configure_gru_transformer_base_architect: configure the gru_transformer base architecture with default encoder and decoder dimensions of 512 and 2048
configure_gru_transformer_big_architectu: configure the gru_transformer_big architecture with larger 1024 encoder dimensions and 16 attention heads
